summary: Excellent, comprehensive wireframe specification that thoroughly documents the Planet Management UI with all required elements. The document provides detailed ASCII wireframes for production sliders (SHIP, DEF, IND, ECO, TECH), population display with worker allocation, factory status, building queue, ship construction progress, and defense/ecology panels. All 5 sliders are fully documented with lock states, percentage displays, output calculations, and progress indicators. Slider interaction states (6 states: default, locked, hover, active drag, warning, completed) are comprehensively specified with detailed pseudocode for the adjustment algorithm. The specification includes responsive layouts for desktop (1920x1080), laptop (1366x768), tablet (1024x768), and mobile (375x667). Implementation-ready elements include: complete keyboard shortcuts table, animation specifications with durations, color specifications for all states, accessibility features (ARIA labels, high contrast, screen reader support), and a JSON data structure schema for planet state. Consistent with MOO1 mechanics (5 production sliders summing to 100%, lock functionality, proportional adjustment) and properly uses pet-themed naming from LORE.md (Hamsters, Guinea Pigs, etc.). Excellent integration with factory-formulas.md and population-growth.md specifications. Minor issues relate to tooltip accuracy and cross-references, not structural problems.
